Grid 6 by 6. Zero-based ( row , col ). Rows increase down; columns increase right. Start ( 3 , 0 ). Goal ( 2 , 4 ). Obstacles ( 3 , 3 ) ; ( 4 , 2 ) ; ( 4 , 5 ).
